reason: The hypothesis restates the exact mechanism, predicted outcome, and experimental approach already reported in P3, P7, P11, and P14, where nanosegregation of principal elements at grain boundaries was shown to cause ductility loss in single-phase CrMnFeCoNi HEAs. The proposed intervention (thermal aging to promote segregation) and falsification test (APT + toughness measurements) are directly taken from those studies, with only minor rewording and no new alloy, regime, or mechanistic insight.
copied_elements: grain boundary segregation of minor/principal elements reduces cohesion and causes intergranular embrittlement in HEAs
ductility loss at intermediate temperatures without gross precipitates
atom probe tomography to detect GB segregation
fracture toughness/ductility tests to measure embrittlement
falsification by absence of segregation or toughness drop
